channel.desc: Tanina believes that her daughter, Kionna, stole hundreds of dollars from under her mattress years ago, and the accusation still haunts their relationship; Kionna says her mother brings it up every time they argue, and she's had enough -- she's turning to a lie detector test, thinking it will exculpate her once and for all!
